name: GitHub CI Debugging
purpose: Diagnose and fix GitHub Actions workflow failures, matrix mismatches, and flaky pipeline steps.
inputs: Failing GitHub Actions run URL and first error log
Workflow YAML, matrix definition, and runner image
Last green run, dependency changes, and cache keys
outputs: Linked CI diagnosis with first error and failure classification
Minimal workflow or source fix with reproduction evidence
Green rerun confirmation and recurrence-hardening record
stop_conditions: The previously failing job is green with linked cause, minimal fix, and hardening evidence
